what_happened: Scene layout 10 (grey shaker cabinets, white geometric backsplash; robot right of the dishwasher; same kitchen as successes s7 and s29), white/pink cup_5 and striped bowl_6. Stage 0, cup first: grasped 113-127 (lift 0.041), carried to the slid-out rack; while held it rested on the rack's side edge (at_target 247-293, the wrist at 264-300 shows the rack's side rail crossing the view next to the cup). Released 299: the cup dropped 0.445 m past the edge of the rack and landed upright on the open door beside/in front of the rack (wrist 304-316: small red circle far below the rack; agent view 316-400: red cup at the door level below the rack). Stage 0 held for 1 step only (584). The bowl was grasped 404-415, brought to the same side of the rack and released 582 on the rack edge (at_target flickering 567-584); it slid off and dropped 0.349 m onto the cup on the door (wrist 592-688: bowl resting on the cup outside the rack, below the rack level). The policy carried on as if loading were done: it pushed the rack into the tub (~700-800) and closed the door 928-1008 (closedness 1.00 at 1008, 0.96 at the end), which swept both dishes into the bottom of the tub (end z 0.21 and 0.24, 6-8 cm outside the interior box). Neither dish touches the top rack at the end.
causal_chain: cup released at 299 while resting on the rack's side edge -> fell 0.45 m off the rack onto the open door -> bowl released at the same edge at 582 -> slid off onto the cup -> rack pushed in and door closed over the fallen dishes (993) -> no dish on the top rack -> stage 0 incomplete at the end
self_recovery: none: the policy never looked for or re-picked the fallen dishes; it continued with the rack and door.
official_criterion_notes: Stage 2's door fixture shows done 993-1200 (closed) although stage 0 and 1 never held; fixture done != stage done. dist_to_target for both dishes at the end (0.057, 0.079) is small although they are not on the rack.
